info.title: RenderCloud OpenAPI
info.description:
RenderCloud OpenAPI provides OpenUSD offline rendering and realtime rendering session capabilities.

Long-running APIs use the same endpoint for submit and polling. Omit `operationId` when submitting. The service returns an `Operation` containing `operationId`; use that `operationId` to poll the same endpoint for the final result.

servers.description: Aholo OpenAPI gateway. China: api.aholo3d.cn; International: api.aholo.ai

tags.name: RenderCloudOpenUSDGuide

post.summary: Submit or poll an OpenUSD offline render job
post.description:
Submit an OpenUSD offline render job or poll the status of an existing job.

## Submit mode

When `operationId` is empty, a new job is submitted. `requestId` and Base64-encoded `usdContent` are required. The output resolution is read from OpenUSD `RenderSettings.resolution`, with Camera `resolution` supported as a compatibility fallback. Width and height must be positive, and neither side may exceed the server-side configured limit. The default limit is 4500 pixels.

The server returns HTTP 202 with `{operationId, metaData:null, done:false, result:null, error:null}`. The `operationId` is the render task ID.

`requestId` is generated by the caller and used for request tracing and records. The server applies a 1-minute idempotency guard for the same user and the same `requestId`. If the same user submits the same `requestId` again within 1 minute, the API returns 409 `ALREADY_EXISTS`.

## Poll mode

When `operationId` is present, the same POST endpoint polls the job status.

- Processing: `done=false`
- Succeeded: `done=true + result.taskId/resultUrl`
- Failed: `done=true + error`

## Rendering constraints

This API does not accept server-side rendering template parameters. The service selects a fixed offline rendering pipeline according to the OpenUSD content and output resolution.

## REST response statuses

| HTTP status | Scenario | Response |
|-----------|------|---------|
| `202` | Submit mode | Job accepted; returns `operationId` for polling |
| `200` | Poll mode | Returns current `Operation`; completed responses include `resultUrl` |
| `400` | Invalid argument | Missing `requestId` or `usdContent`; missing/invalid OpenUSD resolution; invalid Base64; or OpenUSD parse failure |
| `404` | Not found | No job exists for `operationId` |
| `409` | Duplicate request | The same user submitted the same `requestId` again within 1 minute |
| `429` | Rate limited | User-level offline render frequency exceeded |
| `500` | Internal error | Job creation, conversion, or render dispatch failed |

post.summary: Create or poll an OpenUSD realtime render stream
post.description: Create a realtime render session or poll an existing session. ## Submit mode When `operationId` is empty, a new session is created. `requestId` and `usdContent` are required. Optional `settings.autoEnhanceAI` enables AI enhancement. Omit it or set it to `false` to disable enhancement. The server returns HTTP 202 with `{operationId, metaData:null, done:false, result:null, error:null}`. The returned `operationId` is the `sessionId`. ## Poll mode When `operationId` is present, poll the session status. Recommended polling interval is 2 seconds; timeout is 120 seconds. When `status` is `ACTIVE`, `result` contains `host`, `nodeId`, `streamId`, and `token`, which are required to open the WebSocket Streaming connection. ## REST response statuses | HTTP status | Scenario | Response | |-----------|------|---------| | `202` | Submit mode | Session is being created; returns `operationId` for polling | | `200` | Poll mode | Current `Operation`; processing is `done=false`, success is `done=true + result`, failure is `done=true + error` | | `400` | Invalid argument | Request body is missing required fields or contains invalid values | | `404` | Not found | `operationId` or session does not exist | | `429` | Rate limited | Request frequency exceeded | | `500` | Internal error | Internal server error | ## WebSocket Streaming protocol ### Connection URL ``` wss://{host}/streaming/ws/session?nid={encodeURIComponent(nodeId)}&token={encodeURIComponent(token)} ``` Set `ws.binaryType = 'blob'` when creating the WebSocket; otherwise image frames cannot be received as Blob objects. ### Handshake Immediately after WebSocket `onopen`, send: ```json {"type":3,"slaveInit":{"masterStreamingId":"{streamId}","receiveImage":true}} ``` | Field | Value | Description | |------|-----|------| | type | fixed `3` | Slave initialization message | | slaveInit.masterStreamingId | `{streamId}` | The streamId returned by this API | | slaveInit.receiveImage | fixed `true` | Receive rendered images | ### Server messages JSON status messages are received when `typeof event.data === 'string'`. Binary image messages are JPEG Blob objects. Convert the Blob with `FileReader.readAsDataURL(blob)` before assigning it to an `` source. Status codes: | code | Meaning | Connection state change | |------|------|-------------| | `"0"` | Initialized | Success | | `"1000"` | Node overloaded | Error | | `"1001"` | Initialization failed | Error | | `"1003"` | Slave limit exceeded | SlaveExceeded | | `"2001"` | Engine render error | No connection state change; only render failure callback | | `"2002"` | Engine process error | No connection state change; only render failure callback | Close the WebSocket first, then call the DELETE API to end the server-side session.

requestBody.description: Realtime render stream creation or poll request body. Create with `requestId`, `usdContent`, and optional `settings` (currently `autoEnhanceAI`); poll with only `operationId`.

submit.description: Create a render stream with AI enhancement enabled.

poll.description: Use the `operationId` returned by creation to query stream status.

200.description: Realtime render stream polling result. When status is ACTIVE, result contains WebSocket connection parameters.

processing.description: The realtime render stream is still initializing.

success.description: The realtime render stream is ready and returns connection parameters.

failed.description: The realtime render stream failed to initialize.

error.message: code: INTERNAL, details: ErrorDetails(reason=INTERNAL_ERROR, message=null, domain=render, metaData=null)

processing.description: The submit response. `operationId` is the sessionId.

post.summary: Push incremental OpenUSD content to a realtime render stream
post.description:
Apply incremental scene updates to an established realtime render session.

This API is used after the WebSocket Streaming session is ready. It pushes Base64-encoded incremental OpenUSD content to the server. The incremental content may describe camera, model, light, or environment-light patches; the server converts it into render operations and dispatches it to the realtime render pipeline. See the `RenderCloud OpenUSD Format Guide` for the USDA formats.

## Requirements

- `sessionId` must be the `operationId` returned by `/rendercloud/v1/streams` after creation.
- Session status must be `ACTIVE`, otherwise the update is rejected.
- `requestId` is generated by the caller for idempotency and request records.
- `usdContent` is Base64-encoded incremental OpenUSD content.

## REST response statuses

| HTTP status | Scenario | Response |
|-----------|------|---------|
| `200` | Updated | Returns session ID and current session status |
| `400` | Invalid argument | Missing `requestId` or `usdContent`, or invalid request body |
| `404` | Not found | No session exists for `sessionId` |
| `429` | Rate limited | User-level realtime render frequency exceeded |
| `500` | Internal error | Session is not ACTIVE, forwarding failed, or update was rejected by the render pipeline |

requestBody.description: Realtime render stream incremental update request body. `usdContent` is Patch USDA for a camera, model, light, or environment light.

update.description: Push camera, model, light, or environment-light Patch OpenUSD content to an existing realtime render stream.

success.description: Session remains ACTIVE and incremental content has been sent to the realtime render pipeline.

delete.description:
Close the specified realtime render session and release server-side resources.

When closing a realtime render stream, close the WebSocket first, then call this API to end the server-side session. The server releases resources related to the realtime rendering session.

## REST response statuses

| HTTP status | Scenario | Response |
|-----------|------|---------|
| `200` | Closed | `closed=true` means the server found and closed the session; `closed=false` means the session no longer exists or was already cleaned up |
| `404` | Not found | The node that owns the session reports that the session does not exist |
| `429` | Rate limited | User-level realtime render frequency exceeded |
| `500` | Internal error | Forwarding failed or an internal server error occurred |

closed.description: The server found and closed the session.

alreadyGone.description: The session was already closed, timed out, cleaned up, or is not on the current node.

post.summary: Create a 3D parsing and ingestion task
post.description:
Create a 3D parsing and ingestion task to process a raw 3D file URL.

Specify the original 3D file URL with `originMeshUrl`. The optional `fastUpload` field enables fast upload and defaults to `false`.
When `fastUpload` is `true` and the file is in GLB format, the fast upload workflow is used. If omitted or set to `false`, the standard upload workflow is used.

## REST Response Status

| HTTP Status | Scenario | Response Description |
|-----------|------|---------|
| `200` | Task created successfully | Returns the task ID |
| `400` | Invalid arguments | `originMeshUrl` missing or invalid |
| `500` | Internal error | Task creation or processing error |

requestBody.description: Mesh upload and process task request body.

submit.summary: Create a 3D parsing and ingestion task
submit.description: Submit a raw Mesh URL using the standard upload workflow. fastUpload can also be omitted and defaults to false.

fastSubmit.summary: Create a fast GLB upload task
fastSubmit.description: Submit an original GLB file URL and enable fast upload.

200.description: Mesh upload and parse task created successfully.

success.description: Returns the task ID for subsequent queries.

get.summary: Query 3D parsing and ingestion task status
get.description:
Query the status and result of a specified 3D parsing and ingestion task.

This API is used to query the task execution status and result. During the query, data that should not be exposed to users is filtered out,
and the output data is wrapped for processing.
Task status: `0`=INIT, `1`=RUNNING, `3`=SUCCESS, `4`=FAIL

## Requirements

- `taskid` must come from the task ID returned by the task creation API

## REST Response Status

| HTTP Status | Scenario | Response Description |
|-----------|------|---------|
| `200` | Query succeeded | Returns task details |
| `400` | Invalid arguments | `taskid` missing or invalid |
| `404` | Task not found | Specified task ID does not exist |
| `500` | Internal error | Query error |

rateLimited.description: The user-level request frequency exceeds the current API limit.

usdContent.description: Base64-encoded OpenUSD text or binary content.

usdContent.description: Base64-encoded OpenUSD text or binary content.

settings.description: Optional realtime-render session configuration. Server defaults apply when omitted.

autoEnhanceAI.description: Enable AI enhancement. Enabling it increases per-frame processing latency.

currentQueuePosition.description: Current queue position. `0` means the session is ready.

nodeId.description: Value of the `nid` query parameter in the WebSocket URL.

streamId.description: Value of `slaveInit.masterStreamingId` in the WebSocket handshake message.

token.description: Authentication token required to establish the realtime render stream.

RealtimeSessionUpdateRequest.description: Realtime render stream incremental update request body.

RealtimeSessionUpdateResponse.description: Realtime render stream incremental update response body.

RealtimeSessionCloseResponse.description: Realtime render stream close response body.

closed.description: Whether the server found and closed the session.

RealtimeSessionProcessingOperation.description: Realtime render stream creation processing state.

RealtimeSessionSuccessOperation.description: Realtime render stream creation success state.

OperationMetaData.description: Long-running operation metadata. This API usually returns null.

Int2.description: Two-dimensional integer vector. Used for output resolution, where `x` is width and `y` is height.

RenderCloudSessionStatus.description:
Realtime render stream session status.

- `INITIALIZING`: The session has been created and the backend is establishing the streaming connection.
- `ACTIVE`: The streaming connection is ready and can render normally.
- `FAILED`: Initialization or operation failed.
- `CLOSED`: The session has been closed.

ApiError.description: Standard OpenAPI gateway error response. For async operation failures, this object is returned in `Operation.error`.

message.description: Human-readable error message. It may include error details forwarded by the gateway.
message.example: code: INTERNAL, details: ErrorDetails(reason=INTERNAL_ERROR, message=null, domain=render, metaData=null)

ErrorDetails.description: Extended error details forwarded by the gateway.

domain.description: Error domain. Examples use a generic value and do not expose internal service domains.

MeshUploadProcessRequest.description: Mesh upload and parsing task request body.

originMeshUrl.description: URL of the original Mesh file. Cloud-hosted URLs must be publicly accessible. If the file is stored only locally, upload it first through the [Asset Upload](https://labs.aholo.ai/api-docs/en/api-reference#tag/asset) endpoint to obtain a URL, then populate this field with that URL.

fastUpload.description: Whether to enable fast upload. Optional; defaults to false. When fastUpload is true and the file is in GLB format, the fast upload workflow is used. If omitted or false, the standard upload workflow is used.

TaskCreateResponse.description: Task creation response using the standard Result format.

errorMsg.description: Error message. Null when the request succeeds.

TaskQueryResponse.description: Task query response using the standard Result format.

errorMsg.description: Error message. Null when the request succeeds.

data.description: Data payload. Null when an error occurs.

status.description:
Task status:
- `0`: INIT
- `1`: RUNNING
- `3`: SUCCESS
- `4`: FAIL

outputs.description: Task output asset list. Null while the task is processing.

sourceReferId.description: Source asset reference ID, such as a product ID.

content.description:
Asset content:
- For Mesh upload task input: original Mesh URL
- For Mesh upload task output: parsed meshId
